entities.text: High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The principal argument of Mr. Kavina, the learned Senior Advocate appearing for the applicant - original accused No.3 is that although the applicant was a Director at a point of time in the company alleged to have committed the offence under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, yet had resigned as a Director of the company on 2.4.2012.

He invited my attention to Section 66 of the Act, 2006, which creates a vicarious liability of the person who, at the time of the offence,
is said to be in charge of, and responsible to the company for the conduct of the business of the company.

Mr. Kavina read over the entire complaint and prima-facie it appears that there is not a single averment in the complaint lodged by the Food Safety Officer of the Junagadh Municipal Corporation, that the applicant herein is the Director of the company and is responsible for the day-to-day affairs and management of the same.
